name: youtube-channel-scraper
title: YouTube Channel Scraper: Stats, Videos & Engagement
description: Scrape public YouTube channels and latest videos in fast or detailed mode. Get channel-tab links, websites, classified social/community profiles, subscribers, total views, country, video engagement, tags, and category—without collecting emails.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

channel-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once per saved channel, including its available fast or detailed latest-video rows.
